defs.def: of the poorest quality or lowest standard; worse than any other person or thing of a similar kind * bad 的最高级adverbnounverb

ex.s: Although my daughter didn’t win, she did help expose one of the worst pieces of advice I have ever given.
ex.t: 尽管我女儿没有赢，但她确实帮我暴露了我曾给过的最糟糕的建议之一。

ex.s: At worst, you will have refreshed and deepened your knowledge of the rules you normally apply, so that you can be even more effective next time.
ex.t: 最坏的情况是，你复习并加深了对通常所运用规则的理解，以便下次能更加高效。
行动是忧虑最大的敌人。

ex.s: As quantum computing attracts more attention and funding, researchers may mislead investors, journalists, the public and, worst of all, themselves about their work’s potential.
ex.t: 随着量子计算吸引更多关注和资金，研究者可能误导投资者、记者、公众，最糟的是，误导他们自己关于工作潜力的认知。

ex.s: “My husband is the worst page turner,” she laughed.
ex.t: "我丈夫是最糟糕的翻谱员，"她笑着说。

ex.s: Humor lets you better understand life and sometimes helps you laugh at even the worst of your problems.
ex.t: 幽默让你更好地理解生活，有时甚至能让你对最糟糕的问题一笑置之。

ex.s: The worst one happened in seventh grade.
ex.t: 最糟糕的一次发生在七年级。

ex.s: Scammers follow money，so companies will be the worst hit.
ex.t: 骗子跟着钱走，所以企业将受到最严重的打击。

ex.s: He fears the worst, but hopes for the best
ex.t: 他做最坏的打算，但抱最好的希望。

ex.s: Policymakers should start thinking now about how to make sure the appearance of driverless vehicles doesn’t extend the worst aspects of the car-controlled transportation system we have today.
ex.t: 政策制定者现在就应该开始思考，如何确保无人驾驶车辆的出现不会放大我们今天这种以汽车为主导的交通体系中最糟糕的方面。

ex.s: Interruptions are one of the worst things to deal with while you’re trying to get work done.
ex.t: 打扰是你努力工作时最令人头疼的事情之一。

ex.s: Interruptions are one of the worst things to deal with while you’re trying to get work done.
ex.t: 打扰是你努力工作时最令人头疼的事情之一。

ex.s: Think about the singing "Home is where you are loved the most and act the worst".
ex.t: 想想那句歌词“家是你被爱得最多、也表现得最糟的地方”。

ex.s: What's the best / worst thing about…?
The main reason was… The best/worst thing is… My biggest challenge was… What keeps me going is… I hope that… It's been a pleasure.
ex.t: 主要原因是…… 最好/最坏的事情是…… 我最大的挑战是…… 让我坚持下去的是…… 我希望…… 很高兴。

ex.s: (Picture) The 8.1-magnitude Earthquake that hit Nepal on 25 April 2015, was one of the worst earthquakes in history.
ex.t: （图）2015年4月25日袭击尼泊尔的8.1级地震是历史上最严重的地震之一。

ex.s: It was said to be the worst in 60 years, and not a single drop of rain fell for almost a whole year.
ex.t: 据说这是60年来最严重的一次，几乎整整一年没有下一滴雨。
